content.scenario: The Central Government establishes the Central Consumer Protection Council to advise on consumer protection matters. A consumer in Delhi wants to know the role of the Council.
content.outcome: The Central Consumer Protection Council is established by the Central Government to provide advice, but its powers and jurisdiction are not specified in the Act.

user_queries: What is the role of the Central Consumer Protection Council?
How is the Central Consumer Protection Council established?
What are the powers of the Central Consumer Protection Council?
